curation_adjustments.reason: Exclude an introductory region with sparse speech captions and sparse ASR recovery. Actual 30s Reazon probes from the old start produced only 10-16 characters; supplementary captions identify sustained discussion after 67.75s. This is pre-freeze source curation, not tuning on app benchmark outputs; no listening claimed.

selection_rules.candidate_pool: Pinned ja000 shard 00000000; first/middle caption samples inspected from all 73 records, with additional selected-record excerpts; only three selected conversational/response candidates extracted for preparation.
selection_rules.general: Casual chat prioritized before work/discussion. Zero verified casual-chat windows in inspected shard. Provisional bonsai work/discussion pool: five 180s windows from Yr7rGfescvQ and three 240s windows from YvBXxjwqeTy. Fixed-seed sampling selects four and two respectively, then shuffles; no app results used.
selection_rules.eligibility: Japanese-language real speech, multiple acoustic speakers and conversational interaction. Acoustic/ASR evidence only; no listening was available. Suitability is NOT established by dataset language tag or captions alone.
selection_rules.stress: Predeclared three 200s exercise-response candidate windows, separate from general. Count acoustic pauses, short responses, speaker changes and overlap estimates; do not assert human stress labels or equal semantic counts.
selection_rules.isolation: No main/dev/reserve source-time overlap. Heldout extraction must further reject estimated overlap/other-speaker intrusion; isolation remains automatic, not human verified.

elapsed_budget.accounting: Five internal general gaps plus general-to-stress gap assigned to general; two internal stress gaps assigned to stress. Source audio totals1784s plus16s separators.
elapsed_budget.word_boundary_basis: Estimated acoustic silence plus aligned-word/untimed-block exclusion, not human listening.

speakers.embedding_terms: upstream 3D-Speaker Apache-2.0; exported file asset-specific evidence not independently established
speakers.uncertainty: Labels can merge different speakers or split one voice. Counts and overlap are automatic estimates, not participant identities.

process.audio: Crop, FFmpeg dynamic loudnorm I=-23 TP=-2 LRA=7, 48k mono PCM16, 2s interchunk gaps, no speech synthesis or long-gap compression
process.word_timing: Actual CTC constrained Viterbi character occupancy grouped by fugashi/UniDic lexical words; OOV acoustic wildcard states preserve supported surrounding constraints while words containing OOV characters retain null times; never substitute token points
process.punctuation: Insert punctuation only at acoustic/estimated speaker/ASR-window boundaries; no word rewriting; sentence-like units not syntactically verified
process.captions: Supplementary candidate selection only, never copied into references or public metadata
process.independence: ReazonSpeech differs from explicitly planned evaluated ASRs, but PP4 CPU-auto ASR remains unresolved; no claim of disjoint training data
